key_terms.الضُّعَفَاءِ: The weak narrators, referring to those with less precision or reliability in hadith transmission.

ai.seo_question: Who is al-Husayn ibn Asad al-Basri in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of al-Du'afa (The Weak) identifies al-Husayn ibn Asad al-Basri as a narrator who is characterized by his transmission from weak narrators, indicating a specific quality in his chain of transmission.
